paragraphs.text: The Deck Builder's Toolkit (Shadows over Innistrad Edition) is a box set that was released on April 8, 2016. It contains 100 basic land cards (20 of each type from Shadows over Innistrad ), 85 fixed cards, 40 of 110 semi- randomized cards suitable for building several different Magic decks, and four 15-card booster packs , two from Battle for Zendikar and two from Shadows over Innistrad . A deck builder's guide with tips about building the best Magic decks, a Magic "learn to play" guide and a full-art reusable card storage box. All the fixed and semi-random cards in the box are from Shadows over Innistrad , Oath of the Gatewatch , Battle for Zendikar and Welcome Deck 2016 .
